content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
wheel:
- 22.09 mm seat: goes in, pretty snug; holds upside down.
- the roof over the pocket: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.
inner_spacer:
- I printed it, but I can't tell you how it came out.
outer_spacer:
- I printed it, but I can't tell you how it came out.
fit_coupon:
- 22.09 mm seat: goes in, pretty snug; holds upside down.
- the roof over the pocket: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

reasoning:
I'm weighing how to fix the roof over the bottom pocket, since the shoulder ceiling is an unsupported annular overhang that won't print. One option is a 45° chamfered underside on the shoulder, which would keep the bearing seat intact. The other is dropping the shoulder and running a full-width 22.1 through-bore, with the bearings held only by the inner spacer, though I'm not sure they'd stay put axially.

I'm checking whether the bearings can stay put without a shoulder: the inner spacer and clamped bolt would fix the inner rings, and the press fit would hold the outer rings, so the wheel would float but it's acceptable. A shoulder still seems better, so I'm looking at the bridging trick, where the first layer over the pocket is bridged across the 22 mm span.

I'm working through the bridging for the roof: a 16 mm slot in the first layer over the 22 mm pocket, then a 16×16 square on the next layer to bridge across it, then the circular hole from there up. The square's corners poke slightly past the pocket radius, but they sit over solid wall, so that's only a small notch and fine.

I'm checking the press-fit allowance next: 0.1 mm already gives a 22.1 seat, so I'll keep it and apply the same shoulder-hole helper to the coupon as well.

{"params": {"bearing_od":{"value":22,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"re-measured square across the outer ring; 608 nominal 22.000"},"bearing_w":{"value":7,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bearing_inner_land_d":{"value":12,"kind":"hardware","source":"datasheet","note":"approx OD of 608 inner ring; spacers must stay under this"},"bolt_d":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"wheel_od":{"value":50,"kind":"world","source":"asked","note":"old wheel 'about 50 mm'"},"wheel_w":{"value":16,"kind":"world","source":"asked","note":"old wheel 'about 16 mm'"},"press_allow":{"value":0.1,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"confirmed by coupon round 1: snug, holds upside down"},"lead_in":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"shoulder_hole_d":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"between inner-ring land (12) and outer-ring bore (~19)"},"layer_h":{"value":0.2,"kind":"world","source":"asked","note":"printer layer height; sets the two sacrificial-bridge layers of the shoulder"},"tread_chamfer":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"spacer_od":{"value":11.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"spacer_clear":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"outer_spacer_t":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_od":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"}}, "parts": [{"id":"wheel","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat face on the bed, axis vertical","use_orientation":"axis horizontal on the bolt, tread on the rail","code":"def build(p):
    pd = p.bearing_od + p.press_allow
    z0 = p.bearing_w
    w = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.wheel_od/2).extrude(p.wheel_w).edges().chamfer(p.tread_chamfer)
    pk = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(pd/2).extrude(p.bearing_w)
    w = w.cut(pk).cut(pk.translate((0,0,p.wheel_w - p.bearing_w)))
    # roof over the bottom pocket, printed as stepped bridges
    s = p.shoulder_hole_d
    slot = cq.Workplane('XY').box(s, pd, p.layer_h, centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,z0))
    sq = cq.Workplane('XY').box(s, s, p.layer_h, centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,z0 + p.layer_h))
    hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(s/2).extrude(p.wheel_w).translate((0,0,z0 + 2*p.layer_h))
    w = w.cut(slot).cut(sq).cut(hole)
    c1 = cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(pd/2 + p.lead_in, pd/2, p.lead_in))
    c2 = cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(pd/2, pd/2 + p.lead_in, p.lead_in, cq.Vector(0,0,p.wheel_w - p.lead_in)))
    return w.cut(c1).cut(c2)
"},{"id":"inner_spacer","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat on the bed","use_orientation":"on the bolt between the two bearings' inner rings","code":"def build(p):
    t = p.wheel_w - 2*p.bearing_w
    return cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.spacer_od/2).circle((p.bolt_d + p.spacer_clear)/2).extrude(t)
"},{"id":"outer_spacer","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat on the bed","use_orientation":"on the bolt between each bearing inner ring and the bracket plate","code":"def build(p):
    return cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.spacer_od/2).circle((p.bolt_d + p.spacer_clear)/2).extrude(p.outer_spacer_t)
"},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat face on the bed, pocket opening down, same as the wheel","use_orientation":"test only: press one bearing in, check the roof","code":"def build(p):
    pd = p.bearing_od + p.press_allow
    z0 = p.bearing_w
    h = p.bearing_w + (p.wheel_w - 2*p.bearing_w)
    s = p.shoulder_hole_d
    b = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_od/2).extrude(h)
    b = b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(pd/2).extrude(p.bearing_w))
    slot = cq.Workplane('XY').box(s, pd, p.layer_h, centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,z0))
    sq = cq.Workplane('XY').box(s, s, p.layer_h, centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,0,z0 + p.layer_h))
    hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(s/2).extrude(h).translate((0,0,z0 + 2*p.layer_h))
    b = b.cut(slot).cut(sq).cut(hole)
    return b.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(pd/2 + p.lead_in, pd/2, p.lead_in)))
"}], "hardware": [{"id":"axle","ref":"ISO 4762 M8x35","qty":1},{"id":"locknut","ref":"ISO 10511 M8","qty":1}], "joints": [{"id":"axle_joint","fastener":"axle","nut":"locknut","axis_origin":[0,0,-6],"axis_dir":[0,0,1],"external":"door roller bracket side plates (bolt passes through both)","seats":[{"part":"outer_spacer","feature":"bore","role":"clearance"},{"part":"wheel","feature":"shoulder hole / bearing bores","role":"clearance"},{"part":"inner_spacer","feature":"bore","role":"clearance"},{"part":"outer_spacer","feature":"bore","role":"clearance"}]}], "criteria": [{"id":"bearing_press","part":"wheel","feature":"bearing pocket","relation":"seats","params":["bearing_od","press_allow","bearing_w"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Bearing presses in snug, holds upside down (passed round 1)"}},{"id":"roof_bridge","part":"wheel","feature":"shoulder roof over bottom pocket","relation":"supports","params":["shoulder_hole_d","layer_h","bearing_od"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Roof prints as straight bridges, with no loose loops. The 16 mm hole is clear and the bearing sits flat against the shoulder"}},{"id":"spacer_ring","part":"inner_spacer","feature":"outer diameter","relation":"clears","params":["spacer_od","bearing_inner_land_d"],"check":{"method":"measure","description":"Spacer OD < bearing inner ring OD so it touches only the inner ring"}},{"id":"bracket_fit","part":"wheel","feature":"overall width","relation":"clears","params":["wheel_w","outer_spacer_t"],"check":{"method":"measure","description":"Wheel plus outer spacers fits between bracket plates; leave out outer spacers if tight"}}], "manual": [{"n":"1","text":"Print fit_coupon first. Look up into the pocket. The roof should be two layers of straight bridges: first two strips across, then a square, then the 16 mm round hole. There should be no loose loops. Use a knife to clean off any strings at the edge of the hole. Press in a bearing and check it sits flat against the roof and holds.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"Print the wheel flat, with 6 walls and 40%+ infill. Print inner_spacer and two outer_spacer rings. Your existing spacers are fine; they haven't changed.","parts":["wheel","inner_spacer","outer_spacer"]},{"n":"3","text":"Press the first bearing into one side of the wheel until it bottoms on the middle shoulder. Push only on the outer ring. Drop inner_spacer into the bore from the other side so it rests on the first bearing's inner ring. Then press in the second bearing.","parts":["wheel","inner_spacer"],"tool":"vise or flat block"},{"n":"4","text":"Slide the wheel into the bracket with an outer_spacer on each side, between the bearing and the bracket plate. If it's too tight, leave them out. Push the M8 bolt through. You can use your own bolt if it's long enough, or the M8x35. Fit the lock nut and tighten until snug. The wheel must still spin freely.","parts":["wheel","outer_spacer"],"hardware":["axle","locknut"],"tool":"6 mm hex key, 13 mm spanner"}], "note": "Round 2: I changed the roof over the bottom pocket so it builds as stepped bridges (a 16 mm slot, then a 16 mm square, then the round hole), so nothing prints over thin air. The 22.1 mm pocket fit stays the same. The rim is still flat because I don't know the rail shape."}
